section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1979
title: 13 ## Accidental Deaths by Age-Group : The Accidental Deaths reported during 1979 have been further analysed according to age group of the victims. On the all-India level, the maximum number of accidental deaths occurred in the age group of 18-30 years which accounted for 36·4 percent of the total accidental deaths, followed by age group 30—50 years which accounted for 29·1 percent while 21·5 percent of the total accidental deaths occurred the age group below 18 years, 13·0 percent deaths were recorded in the age group above 50 years.
